description: Offline renders and charts. A render stops the live audio for its duration (about 2 s) and the route restarts it; renders run freely with audio off (act tier, user decision D3, 2026-10-15) and ask first while live audio runs (assistant R6, dev-947d).

commands.name: render.chart_types
commands.title: List chart and action types
commands.description: The chart registry: chart types with their parameter schemas, action types, dynamic charts.

commands.name: render.chart
commands.title: Render a chart
commands.description: Renders any registered chart type (see render.chart_types) with its chart-specific parameters. Returns data, headers and, for sound charts, audio_data (base64 WAV).

commands.name: render.note_playback
commands.title: Render one note offline
commands.description: Deterministic offline render of a single note (the audio_off verification surface). Returns the waveform chart and audio_data (base64 WAV).

commands.name: render.keyboard
commands.title: Render the keyboard sweep offline
commands.description: Stops the online engine, renders the NOTE_ON/NOTE_OFF sweep offline into a peak-normalised mono WAV of one output channel (audio_data base64; channel, default 0), then restarts the engine.

speed_ms_per_note.description: NOTE_ON to NOTE_OFF duration per key, ms

pitches.description: Explicit pitch list; omit for all pitches

channel.description: Output channel written to the mono WAV (0 = output pitch 128); the result names num_channels
